title: Tool detection and GitHub identity: Claude Code and gh installed and signed in, login, name and email, guidance text
summary: Grillo's main process now checks whether Claude Code and gh are installed and signed in (with a 10-second cache and structured guidance) and reads the member's GitHub login, name and email, over two IPC channels for the later setup screen.
friction: A round-1 Fix now (`gh auth status --active`) introduced a regression on gh older than 2.57.0, costing a whole extra review round
lessons_learned: A fix that adds a command-line flag checks which tool version introduced it and keeps a fallback for older versions

deferred.what: When a member keeps their GitHub email private the identity email comes back empty, because the email-list fallback needs the `user:email` scope that a plain `gh auth login --web` does not grant
deferred.why: The acceptance criteria fix the sign-in command as exactly `gh auth login --web`; the runbook gives the refresh command
